prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production game terrain-material texture sheet matching the attached richly shaded stylized 3D pirate-village reference. This is a source material atlas for the actual browser game, not a screenshot, no UI, no buildings, no props, no characters, no scenery silhouette, no ocean and no text or labels.

Output ONE perfectly square image divided exactly into a clean 2×2 grid of four equal square material panels, edge-to-edge with NO gutters, outlines, margins or separators. Panels must use the same warm sunlight and richly painted 3D mobile-strategy material quality as the reference, clean softly beveled forms with restrained microdetail and no black cartoon outlines. Use an orthographic straight-on texture view; do not add perspective vanishing points.

TOP LEFT quadrant: rich golden-green lawn grass, small natural tuft detail, broad warm/light variation and soft tiny shadows. It should read as lush maintained village ground, not a checkerboard, aerial farmland, long reeds or photographic noise. Mostly mid-light grass green and chartreuse, subtle darker moss.

TOP RIGHT quadrant: warm pale sandstone path paving, a close-set regular grid of softly beveled rectangular stone pavers and fine darker sandy joints. Small slight wear and warm light from upper-left. Flat ground stone texture with no foliage. Many pavers across the quadrant; not a single huge stone.

BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: substantial tan/gray sandstone cliff rock face made of irregular interlocking faceted stone blocks, thick three-dimensional bevels, warm cream top highlights, brown recessed crevices and cooler shaded lower faces, like the reference island cliff. Frame it as a repeatable material with no turf, no horizon, no external border, no obvious dark edge vignette. This rock material will be clipped to our analytic cliff polygons.

BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: clean warm golden beach sand, softly textured with tiny sparse pebbles, broad subtle natural tonal variation, bright warm beige with slightly darker sparse grains. No footprints, shells, water, plants or cast-object shadows.

All FOUR quadrants tile reasonably in both directions with no dominant center object or vignette. Maximize usable texture area and material consistency. Natural original stylized materials rather than flat vector fill or photographic textures. Four exact equal square quadrants in one square image, high resolution, opaque background.
evidenceBoundary: This generated sheet is a source asset, not an actual gameplay screenshot or final visual acceptance.
